svg.text: 07 · Results from the voice roster, and a correction with its trail (crew, organiser)
Use case: the crew scores a finished match in one pass from the bot's voice roster; later an organiser corrects a result with a reason
Enter the result: semi-final 2, from the voice roster

g.text: Demo Arena 5v5 · Team Beta vs Team Delta · best of three
Voice roster captured 20:13 by the bot · players in a room for 10 min or more
Fills who played; you pick the winner. Presence opt-outs are not in it: add them by hand.
Points when the session ends: winner 3 · runner-up 2 · played 1 · no-show 0 (the event's table).

svg.text: The roster is bot.voice_roster.captured, the answer to tournament.scoring.started (catalog, built) (D4).
The legacy rules: 10 min in a room qualifies; ties and walk-ins are flagged, never guessed (D4).
Nothing is pre-picked: the legacy's 'first room wins by default' trap goes (E13).
Without a roster (bot down, opt-outs) the same page is a plain form (E3, D5).
A correction emits tournament.result.corrected with the whole new list and the reason (D7).
History is the session's audit trail: crew actions, the scheduler, corrections (D7).
